caustica.enhanced.key.toggle.failed: Ray tracing could not resume. Please restart the game.
caustica.enhanced.nebula.tooltip: The nebula in the night sky. Off leaves only stars and the moon.
caustica.enhanced.cloudShadow.tooltip: Shadows cast by clouds blocking the sun. Off keeps the outdoors from dimming under clouds.
Brightness of Overworld nights only; 0.60 is the default, lower dims moonlight and the night sky. Daytime is unaffected.
caustica.enhanced.param.sunDiscSize.tool: Visible size of the sun; 1.00 is the default. Does not change shadows.
caustica.enhanced.sunShape.tooltip: Visible shape of the sun and the moon.
caustica.enhanced.param.sunGlow.tooltip: Strength of the atmospheric glow around the sun; 0 turns it off.
caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.sunSize.tooltip: Angular radius of the sun and moon disk. Larger discs cast softer shadow penumbrae.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.parallax.tooltip: Shift material UVs by the pack's LabPBR height map (the _n alpha). OFF keeps the official look; Smooth adds a short bounded march for real depth occlusion. Only materials that ship a height map are affected and no ray-tracing geometry is added.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Present in HDR (ST.2084/PQ) instead of SDR, when the display supports it. Takes effect after restarting the game.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: Absolute brightness (in nits) that SDR-equivalent scene brightness maps to on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Visualize an intermediate ray-tracing buffer instead of the final image.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.10: Bounce Hit (sky white / contact red / terrain green)
caustica.options.rt.clouds.tooltip: Clouds in sky and reflections; fidelity unaccepted. OFF skips cloud shading.
caustica.options.rt.fg.tooltip: Native NGX backend. Up to %s generated frames; current multiplier %s; %s successful evaluations. %s
caustica.enhanced.presets: Visual presets — preserves RT / DLSS budgets
caustica.enhanced.param.brightness.toolt: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.contrast.tooltip: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.saturation.toolt: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.temperature.tool: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.gamma.tooltip: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.shadowLift.toolt: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.highlightSoftnes: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.adaptUp.tooltip: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.adaptDown.toolti: Live adjustment. Neutral values preserve the calibrated look. Changes are saved.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudCoverage.to: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudDensity.too: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudSize.toolti: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.

Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudBottom.tool: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudSunlight.to: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudSpeed.toolt: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudEdge.toolti: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudCirrus.tool: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.cloudRain.toolti: Live control. Defaults preserve the current cloud model. Coverage, density and size are enhancement controls.
caustica.enhanced.param.parallaxStrength: Height offset multiplier. 1.00 preserves existing depth; no extra rays or geometry.
caustica.enhanced.param.smoothSteps.tool: 2–8: adaptive height search with intersection refinement on camera surfaces. Secondary rays use a cheaper approximation.
caustica.enhanced.rr.tooltip: Combined reconstruction and upscale. OFF traces at native resolution; there is no standalone SR fallback. Switching recreates render targets.
caustica.enhanced.param.heldRadius.toolt: Maximum influence distance in blocks for a level-15 item, scaled for dimmer items. Creative flight limits analytic held lighting to 3 nearby blocks; walking retains this setting.
caustica.enhanced.param.heldBrightness.t: Scales held-light intensity without changing exposure or existing scene lights.
caustica.enhanced.param.wetness.tooltip: Rain-driven wet reflections on exposed upward surfaces; 0 disables wetness.
caustica.enhanced.param.fogDensity.toolt: Single-scattering fog on camera rays; 0 disables air fog and its visibility query.
caustica.enhanced.param.waterScatter.too: Water single-scattering strength; 0 keeps absorption and water ray tracing.
caustica.enhanced.rtEnabled.tooltip: Off uses the raster world fallback and suspends FG. If this session started with RT off, save and restart to enable Vulkan RT features. Sodium is not live-tested.
caustica.enhanced.param.emission.tooltip: Linear emission multiplier for block/PBR emitters and GI, not display exposure.
caustica.enhanced.param.endLight.tooltip: Shadowed direct-light approximation aligned with the black hole; reuses existing NEE.
caustica.enhanced.param.endStars.tooltip: Scales End stars without changing the planet or accretion disc.
caustica.enhanced.param.endSky.tooltip: Scales End background, reflections and sky GI. Direct lighting is separate.
caustica.enhanced.param.endCycle.tooltip: Reference default: 15 minutes. Shared time for the planet, rings and End fog.
caustica.enhanced.param.netherBrightness: Scales Nether background/fog radiance; lava emission remains independent.
caustica.enhanced.param.portal.tooltip: Controls portal emission. End portal layers are independent of block emission gain.
caustica.enhanced.param.specular.tooltip: Scales ordinary PBR F0; physical water/glass reflection is retained.
caustica.enhanced.param.normalStrength.t: Blends texture/height normals with geometric normals; zero helps diagnose packs.
caustica.enhanced.param.reliefShadow.too: Scales local height-field occlusion without removing geometry shadows.
caustica.enhanced.param.puddle.tooltip: Scales wet-surface puddles while preserving relief normals.
caustica.enhanced.param.ripples.tooltip: Scales rainy wet-ground ripple normals, active during rainfall.
caustica.enhanced.param.zeroF0Fallback.t: Minimum F0 only for zero-F0 nonmetal pack materials. Default 0.02; zero preserves authored zero reflectivity.
caustica.enhanced.param.endHalo.tooltip: Low-cost angular halo around the End black hole, including sky reflections. Zero disables; not full-screen bloom.
caustica.enhanced.param.handDepth.toolti: Compresses first-person mesh distance while retaining projected size; reduces wall clipping. 1 restores original depth. Does not remove all animation self-intersections.
caustica.enhanced.param.heldSoftness.too: Zero restores point-light hard shadows; default 0.12 blocks. One visibility ray per sample with temporal soft-shadow convergence.
ITRP default 0.15. Zero restores full occlusion; higher values intentionally brighten occluded areas.
caustica.enhanced.streamline.tooltip: Select the rendering backend for game startup. When launched with Streamline and verified local MFG components, switch 2x/3x/4x in game without restarting for a multiplier change. Switching the Streamline/NGX backend itself still requires a restart.
caustica.options.rt.fg.tooltip.streamlin:
Up to %s generated frames; last confirmed presents %sx; %s option submissions.
Backend status: %s
caustica.enhanced.rrPreset.tooltip: Bundled Streamline 2.14.16 / RR 310.9.16: Auto is runtime-selected; D/E/F are RR Transformer presets (F is the latest default). Legacy NGX 310.7.0 uses Auto/D/E; F requests conservatively use Auto there. Changes recreate the feature and reset history. Effective driver-overridden model is not queryable. SR K/L/M are not RR presets.
caustica.enhanced.srMode.tooltip: Off: RR denoising and reconstruction. On: standalone SR, same quality selection. SR is not a ray denoiser; path-tracing noise may remain. Requires Streamline; unavailable requests use the native reference fallback and log the reason.
caustica.enhanced.srPreset.tooltip: SR 310.9.16: actual SDK Auto/J/K/L/M presets, only in standalone SR mode. RR retains D/E/F. Changes recreate the feature and reset history. Effective driver-overridden model is not queryable.
Scales torch emission and indirect lighting without changing exposure. 1 matches the previous version; default 2.
caustica.enhanced.dhLods.tooltip: Requires DH 3.3.3. Native raster LODs share Caustica fog, exposure and reconstruction; no far TLAS.
caustica.enhanced.dhSecondary.tooltip: Reuse visible LOD depth for first-segment reflections/GI and occlusion. Offscreen/hidden LODs are unavailable. No far TLAS; extra GPU cost is unmeasured. Can be disabled independently.
caustica.options.rt.fg.restartMfg: %sx (MFG component was not loaded at this launch)
caustica.enhanced.param.bloom.tooltip: Bloom strength of the ITRP look; 1 is the default, 0 disables bloom.
caustica.enhanced.param.torchKelvin.tool: Colour temperature of the ITRP held warm light; lower is more orange. Default 3000K.
caustica.enhanced.param.exposureKey.tool: Middle-grey level auto exposure aims for. Default 0.18; higher makes the image brighter.
caustica.enhanced.minEv.tooltip: Darkest exposure auto exposure may use in bright scenes. Default -1.5 EV.
caustica.enhanced.maxEv.tooltip: Brightest exposure auto exposure may use in caves and at night. Default +3.0 EV; lower keeps caves darker.
caustica.enhanced.moonSize.tooltip: Angular radius of the moon disc; larger gives softer night shadows. Default 1.5°.
caustica.enhanced.sunTilt.tooltip: How far the noon sun sits from overhead, so midday still casts angled shadows. Default 30°, 0° is vanilla.
caustica.enhanced.radianceCache.tooltip: Ends long indirect paths with a world-space cache. Clearly faster with a visually matching image.
caustica.enhanced.mirrorPsr.tooltip: Hands the reflected scene of smooth metal mirrors to DLSS RR so distant mirror reflections stay sharp.
caustica.enhanced.nameTags.tooltip: Draw entity name tags in the ray-traced image.
caustica.enhanced.blockOutline.tooltip: Draw the outline of the targeted block in the ray-traced image.
caustica.enhanced.fgMenuDetection.toolti: Pause frame generation while a full-screen menu is open to avoid UI smearing.
caustica.enhanced.reflex.tooltip: Updates live with Streamline; frame generation enables Reflex automatically. Native NGX may require a restart if its device extension was not enabled at startup.
caustica.enhanced.reflexBoost.tooltip: Keeps GPU clocks higher for even lower latency at higher power use.
caustica.enhanced.frameStats.tooltip: Log frame times and hitches. For troubleshooting only; keep off while playing.
caustica.enhanced.gpuTimings.tooltip: Record the GPU time of each render pass. For performance troubleshooting only.
caustica.enhanced.param.detailSharpen.to: ITRP default 1.00: restrained post-tonemap micro-contrast on fine texture, overworld only; flat areas and the sky are untouched. 0 disables.
caustica.enhanced.param.sunRims.tooltip: ITRP default 1.00: a thin rim of sunlight on convex block and leaf edges when backlit, only where the far side is actually lit. 0 disables.
caustica.enhanced.lightSampling.tooltip: Torches, glowstone and other block lights directly light their surroundings: less noise indoors and in caves, at a frame-rate cost. Light: only surfaces you see directly; Full: one more bounce. Off still shows lights, just noisier.
